newsitem.title: UK: English China Clays to cut 300 jobs - PA.
newsitem.headline: English China Clays to cut 300 jobs - PA.

text.p: English China Clays, supplier of minerals and chemicals to the paper industry, will cut 300 jobs, or 10 percent of its workforce, the Press Association news agency said on Monday.
Quoting an English China Clays International spokesman, the news agency said the jobs would go mainly in the St Austell area of Cornwall.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
The job cuts are part of a restructuring programme aimed at saving 30 million pounds ($50 million) on a worldwide basis, PA quoted Clive Grownow, ECCI's European managing director as saying.

The company had given an indication of cutting costs last September when it reported pretax profits of just 5.7 million stg for six months to June 30, 1996 compared to 55.3 million for the same period in the previous year. ($1=.5974 Pound)
